title: Missing security headers
summary: The illustrative response profile does not consistently define browser security headers.
evidence: Example-only observation; replace with sanitized response headers collected during an authorized test.
impact: Weak browser-side controls can increase exposure to content injection and clickjacking when combined with other weaknesses.
remediation: Set a suitable Content-Security-Policy based on application requirements.
Set an appropriate frame-ancestors directive or X-Frame-Options where needed.
Set Referrer-Policy and review permissions policy.
Test changes in staging and monitor for compatibility.

title: Insufficient login throttling
summary: The illustrative design lacks clear evidence of effective rate limiting and abuse detection for repeated failed authentication attempts.
evidence: Example-only design review item; validate in a controlled test account and approved window. Do not conduct password spraying.
impact: Could facilitate account compromise attempts and increase support burden if compensating controls are absent.
remediation: Apply per-account and per-source adaptive throttling with safe thresholds.
Use MFA for privileged and risk-sensitive actions.
Return generic authentication errors to reduce account enumeration.
Alert on unusual failure patterns and test lockout recovery to prevent denial of service.
Document rate limits and verify them with a small, authorized test.

title: Verbose error responses
summary: The illustrative API error response may expose implementation details beyond what clients need.
evidence: Example-only response sample; replace with sanitized evidence from the authorized environment.
impact: Stack traces or internal identifiers can help an attacker prioritize follow-on attempts, though the impact depends on the information exposed.
remediation: Return stable, generic client-facing error messages.
Log diagnostic detail only on the server with access controls.
Use correlation IDs to connect client errors with internal logs.
Add tests ensuring production responses omit stack traces and secrets.
